verdict.rationale: Okta's first-party docs describe Event Hooks: outbound HTTPS REST calls sent to a URL you specify whenever specified events occur in your org. That is a webhook subscription mechanism matching the story's core. The evidence consists of two brief snippets from a single concept page, so depth is thin. Missing for 10: details on choosing and managing event-type subscriptions, delivery verification/signing and retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
